info.name: Estimates - Pipeline Bulk Update
info.description:
Bulk-update the inline Pipeline grid fields on estimates, and GET the estimates to verify the changes.

Update endpoint: PATCH /api/v1/estimates/pipeline
Read endpoints:  GET /api/v1/estimates/search  and  GET /api/v1/estimates/:id
Auth: none (estimate routes are currently unauthenticated).

Suggested flow:
1. Run 'GET - view 5 estimates (before/after)' to see the current values.
2. Run 'Bulk update - 5 records'.
3. Run the same GET again and compare acctManagerId/salesRepName, businessVerticalId/businessVerticalName, esStatusId, projectedTotalAmt, syncStatus, updatedAt, etc.

All IDs below are REAL values from the database:
- Estimates: 244=EST0008746, 243=EST0008745, 242=EST0008744, 241=EST0008743, 240=EST0008742
- Sales Rep (acctManagerId): 344=Abigail Worthington, 345=Alexandra Joneaux, 346=Alexandra Grunstein, 347=Anna Paxton, 402=OBC Dev
- Ops Partner (opsPartner1Id): 11=Cecile Aurran, 12=Chante Fennel, 13=Domestic Team, 29=Korree Jones, 44=Yvonne Flores
- Sales Channel (salesChannelId): 1=CEW UK, 2=Inbounds, 3=Katie Reed, 4=Luxepack LA, 5=Luxepack Monaco
- Category (businessVerticalId): 1=GIFTS & LOYALTY, 2=PRIVATE LABEL, 3=INFLUENCER, 4=PACKAGING, 5=BRANDED MERCHANDISE
- Likely to Close (likelyToCloseId): 4=1-Low, 5=2-Low/Medium, 6=3-Medium, 7=4-Medium/High, 8=5-High
- ES Status (esStatusId): 5=Closed Lost, 6=Converted To Quote, 7=In Progress, 8=Partially Converted
- Product Developers (productDeveloperIds): 122=Ali DiCerbo, 123=Anna Paxton, 124=Annie Conlon, 125=Ashley Bell, 128=Belen De Costi, 131=Brielle Farruggio

request.description: Returns { data: [...], pagination }. Each row includes the grid fields WITH resolved names: acctManagerId/salesRepName, opsPartner1Id/opsPartner1Name, salesChannelId/salesChannelName, businessVerticalId/businessVerticalName, likelyToCloseId/likelyToCloseName, esStatusId, productDeveloperIds, projectedTotalAmt, estimatedQty, expectedCloseDate, promiseDate, syncStatus, updatedAt. Run before and after the update to see the diff.
Full estimate 244 (header + line items). Change 244 to any id (243, 242, 241, 240).

exec: pm.test('all 5 rows succeeded', () => { pm.expect(b.updated).to.eql(5); b.results.forEach(r => pm.expect(r.success, JSON.stringify(r)).to.be.true); });
